source.creditLine: Server counts, player exposure and mod rankings come from the ReforgerMods.net public API (reforgermods.net), an independent, community-run Arma Reforger stats service. Per-mod version and server-list detail for the tracked Project Outbreak add-ons comes from ArmaHQ (armahq.com). ArmaHqStats is not affiliated with ReforgerMods.net, ArmaHQ, or Bohemia Interactive.

workshop.summary: A custom zombie sandbox including slow, fast, and crawling Zombies.
An optional infection system for Project Outbreak that turns infected into Zombies.
An optional destruction system that lets zombie pursuits continue through buildings and compounds by breaking doors and windows.
An equipment pack that gives players more options when a horde closes in.
More civilian zombie appearances for Project Outbreak, including the Handyman, Businesswomen, Firefighter, Zombie Girl, Romero, Zombie Medic and Zombie Worker.
Optional Project Outbreak special zombies and creatures, including the Nephilim and Nightingale.
A Zombie Apocalypse PvE Project Outbreakscenario on the Glenwood terrain.
A lighter Project Outbreak Deadwood: the same self-running PvE zombie scenario on the Glenwood terrain, with only Project Outbreak and the map as dependencies.
Small sword-carrying creatures travel in groups. A larger crimson Blademaster wears layered armour and carries a dark, red-marked blade. Requires Creature Melee AI.
Witnesses report horned humanoids carrying paired axes, alongside heavier fist-fighting forms. Their equipment varies from bone tools to scavenged military kit, a white vest and denim.
Pale, one-eyed organisms strike with claws and charged eye beams. A many-eyed Titan towers over settlements, while the winged form hunts from above and carries people away.
A lean, fast creature that closes on prey and fights at close range.
Fungal organisms have been reported near settlements and abandoned ground. Small clawed forms travel in groups, while larger bodies stand above the canopy and release others from their tissue.
A 21-metre creature with four flexible spotlight heads, a red target warning and heavy Titan footfalls. Early work in progress. Requires Creature Melee AI.
A crawling forest predator with caustic spit and tree ambushes. Includes Game Master groups of 4 and 16. Early work in progress; requires Creature Melee AI.
Grey, Brown, Dark and Ice Werewolves for the Creatures collection, with custom movement, claw attacks and positional sound effects. Requires Creature Melee AI.
A large forest creature with dark fur and a powerful build.
A grinning jester that hides nearby, plays cruel pranks on its prey and keeps the fight going before slipping away.
A scrap-armoured Orc faction for Game Master: Green, White and Black Orcs, roaring Flesh-Saw fighters, crude guns, Warbasha, an armoured troll, Scrap Walker and Wallbreaker artillery.
Shared creature AI for Arma Reforger: hostile targeting, pursuit, melee, carry support and reusable animations. Includes authoring templates and optional Game Master examples.
AI Rearm lets AI request magazines from squadmates, recover compatible ammunition from allowed dead bodies, and visit arsenals. A placeable Game Master settings system controls settings.
A standalone military crossbow with a four-bolt quiver, detachable scope and custom loading animation.
Introduces a mannable Ballista Crowssbow that can be used to kill and hunt dragons

dependents.heading: Built on Project Outbreak Zombies
dependents.discoveryMethod: Pulled live every run from ArmaHQ's own Workshop dependency index (armahq.com's per-mod "Required By" data, api/workshop/dependents/{modId}): every mod ArmaHQ currently sees declaring this one as a Workshop dependency, not a keyword search. First-party Project Outbreak add-ons are dropped from this list since they already have their own section above; download, subscriber and server numbers for the rest are refreshed from ReforgerMods.net every run.
